Description.SourceString:
Adamant is a special metal, responding well to magic and allowing it to be shaped into durable and deadly forms. Adamant bolts are the bane of many creatures, their sharpness and their hardiness lets them pierce through almost any defence.

Yet, what if you didn’t stop the magic in the crafting process? What if you added more and more, creating bolts enchanted with murderous wrath? The answer to that is in these enchanted bolts, that sap your life in order to deal greater damage to your foe.

Sacrifice for vengeance, the gods would approve. 

Except Guthix, but his opinion is somewhat moot these days.
